Issue Franchise

Franchise

Franchise: Merchandise Owns the Ledger

140 franchises on the October 2026 Wikipedia ledger sum to $1.45T lifetime revenue. Merchandise is 55.8%.

Kyle McAuliffe

Published figures

  1. $1,448.1B lifetime revenue, 140 franchises (Wikipedia, Oct 12 2026, S017)
  2. 55.8% merchandise, licensing and retail
  3. $130.7B Pokémon
  4. 94.4% franchise share of 2025's worldwide top-ten box office

One ledger

The public report reads Wikipedia's highest-grossing media franchises list as a ledger of revenue streams. This fixture keeps the section order and the headline figures. It does not reproduce the article.

Research question

How much of the October 2026 ledger sits in merchandise versus box office and games, and how do origin and ownership change that mix?

Note

Data and method

Primary ledger cited on the public page: Wikipedia's list, revision 1379832186 (October 12, 2026). Ranges and cleaning rules stay in the Artometrics article.

Sources

  1. Wikipedia. List of highest-grossing media franchises.
  2. TidyTuesday 2019-07-02 media franchise revenues.
